items.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors to ease AI’s strain on power grids
items.summary:

Its planned Georgia campus is the pilot, with up to 1,000MW of flexible demand. No other sites have been named. items.title: The U.S. Census Bureau and “Super Intelligence”
items.summary:

At the time I used that chart to demonstrate GPT-5 data analysis, and then to experiment with Claude's new Code Interpreter. items.title: Build efficient agents with knowledge distillation on Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: Agentic assistants built on frontier models run a multi-step tool loop, and paying frontier prices on every step is hard to sustain at production scale. This post shows how to use sequence-level knowledge distillation (SeqKD) to transfer a frontier teacher's agentic behavior into a small, lower-cost student on Amazon SageMaker AI.

items.title: AI Won’t Make Our Minds Useless According to 400 Years of History
items.summary: On Long Read Sunday, NLW reads Venkatesh Rao's 'Cognitive Mercantilism.' The essay argues that today's AI panic repeats the zero-sum thinking capitalism overturned 400 years ago. It assumes intelligence is scarce, demand for it is fixed, and most minds are about to become useless. The early modern consumer revolution suggests the opposite may happen.
